text.content:
Everything past the last streetlight.

Region: Outside Night City: the Reclaimed Perimeter and the Open Road
Controlled by: The nomad families, led by the Aldecaldos; NorCal Highway Patrol on the highways it claims
The feel of it: Desert, dead towns, empty NUSA trenches and long roads
Notable locations: The Aldecaldo Camp (#54), the NUSA Line, the Biotechnica Flats, the Sunset Motel, the Wraiths' country
Danger: Outskirts. SC 3: NorCal Highway Patrol and the nomad families, Hardened Light. UC varies

Decades of climate change and stripped resources have turned the land outside Night City into desert. The Aldecaldos and their allies run the trade routes the city depends on, and NorCal still patrols the highways it claims. The I-9 corridor east was a front line until spring 2070; the NUSA positions are empty now, and scavvers are picking them clean.

The Roads

  • Interstate 9 runs east to the NUSA, with checkpoints at the city edge and the border. Convoys only after dark.
  • Highway 101 runs south to SoCal, past the Occupied Zone's checkpoints. Barghest taxes it.
  • The Coast Highway runs north to NorCal. Pretty, empty, and patrolled.
  • Nomad roads go everywhere else, at 50eb per vehicle per day or a favor to the family that runs them.

Places

  • Aldecaldo Camp (#54). A moving town of trucks, trailers and workshops east of the city, with the best mechanics in California.
  • The NUSA Line. Abandoned trenches, bunkers and vehicle parks across the southeast. Some of it still explodes.
  • Biotechnica Flats. Kilometers of fields and protein vats that feed the city, guarded like gold.
  • Sunset Motel. At the edge of the desert, where people go to disappear for a week. Its old nomad owner doesn't ask questions.
  • The Wraiths' country. Raider territory in the north.

Carry fuel and water: the only stations are nomad-run. Some fixers, like Dakota Smith, work from garages out here.

Edgerunner's Handbook p.32; Night City 2070 (The Unification Era), ch.13
